messages:
maria: Ok team, scoped brief: deliver a compact launch copy pack for the three deployment pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) plus social snippets, a one-line benchmark for socials, webinar page copy, and distinct demo routing for inbound leads. Aim to freeze copy by next Wednesday EOD. Base assets: https://tiny.redwood/launch-kit-v2
leo: I'll draft two headline alternatives per page, a 12-15 word subhead, and 2 proof bullets per mode. Tone: pragmatic, product-focused, low hype.
priya: I'll own the webinar landing and three subject lines. Thinking workshop style with short demos + an ops panel. Proposed webinar title: "Inference in the Wild: cost, latency, and control". Suggested date: 2026-07-14.
sam: Social cadence suggestion: Week 1: hosted teaser + signup; Week 1 mid: benchmark thread for dedicated; Week 1 end: private deployment case study + webinar CTA. All posts must have mode-specific UTM and demo slug.
olga: Quick security note: Private page must reference KMS/HSM and on-prem installer but keep hero-level wording generic. Dedicated must include "reserved GPU pools" and an SLA callout. I'll review private copy by Tue noon.
nora: Routing: we'll use distinct demo slugs for clean CRM mapping: /start/hosted?utm_campaign=orbit, /start/dedicated?utm_campaign=orbit, /start/private?utm_campaign=orbit. Recommended form fields: deployment, monthly token estimate, primary use case, contact urgency. Sales wants hosted -> trial queue, dedicated/private -> enterprise queue.
comms-bot: calendar: webinar placeholder created for 2026-07-14 10:00 PT; reminders scheduled 7 days and 1 day prior.
maria: Thanks. We also need three short CTA variants per mode for A/B testing, and a tweet-sized benchmark line (single short sentence). Engineering will approve numbers.
leo: CTA options (short): Hosted: ["Start hosted trial","Try hosted API","Get a hosted demo"]; Dedicated: ["Reserve dedicated capacity","Book capacity demo","Talk SLA options"]; Private: ["Request private deployment","Schedule on-prem demo","Contact enterprise sales"].
priya: Webinar subject A/B: A) "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" B) "Running predictable LLM inference: patterns & tradeoffs" C) "Inference in the Wild: cost, latency, control". Landing hero draft: "Live workshop: practical patterns for cost, latency, and secure deployment." CTA: "Save my seat" / "Register".
sam: Benchmark one-liners (tweet-sized): 1) "95th-pct latency <120ms  3x token savings vs baseline (internal tests)" 2) "<120ms (95th)  up to 3x token cost reduction in our benchmarks"  engineering approval needed. Short alt: "<120ms (95th)  3x token savings."
olga: Engineering to confirm benchmark numbers by Mon EOD. Security will review private copy Tue noon. If any phrases need softening we will keep technical details in the product docs instead of hero copy.
maria: Good. Also: make sure each CTA links to the mode-specific demo slug, and tag experiments with utm_term=ctaA/ctaB. nora, can you make those routes sticky so ad clicks map correctly?
nora: Yep. I'll create the 3 routes and expose unique tracking tokens. I'll also add a hidden field to forms with "mode" so CRM auto-routes leads. Will share a mapping file once done.
leo: Draft hero snippets (quick): Hosted: 1) "Hosted API: inference in minutes" 2) "Launch hosted LLMs with predictable latency." Subhead: "Start a trial, scale quickly, pay-as-you-go."
leo: Dedicated: 1) "Dedicated capacity, predictable throughput" 2) "Reserved GPU pools with SLA-backed performance." Subhead: "Commit to capacity and hit latency targets under load."
leo: Private: 1) "Private deployments: VPC or on-prem" 2) "Bring inference behind your firewall with KMS support." Subhead: "Customer-managed networking, HSM/KMS integrations, and support for air-gapped installs."
priya: Webinar social snippet: "Join our live workshop 7/14: Inference in the Wild  patterns for cost, latency, and secure deployments. Register -> {shortlink}?utm_campaign=orbit"
comms-bot: Reminder queued: review copy session scheduled for 2026-07-07 09:00 PT.
maria: Great thread. Owners: leo = hero + bullets + CTAs; priya = webinar page + emails + social snippets; nora = demo routes + tracking; olga = security review; sam = social cadence and posts. Deliver first drafts by Fri EOD so product can review early next week. Thanks team :raised_hands:
